name: Sedouris
description: Ancient city destroyed by a Cosmic Horror and made Dihada's lair.

timeline.summary: After five years of siege by Sol'Kanar, Dihada summons a Cosmic Horror to eradicate Sedouris.
timeline.quote: Dihada summoned a Cosmic Horror to eradicate the inhabitants of the city

timeline.quote: Dakkon regaining his shadow but also becoming enslaved to Dihada's will
